title.method: Actual exported PNGs and TTF text composed with Pillow, no game or browser implementation.
limitations: Hidden decoration restored by harmonic interpolation.
Glyph contours traced from approved mockup; restricted character sets need system fallback.
Photo plates retain original visible photo pixels, but UI-hidden areas are not clean source photography.
Glass layers use analytic alpha separation; original source layers are unavailable.
